name: scaffold-ocarina
note: prod-scaffold.mjs: readAppFacts + prodScaffold for arugula-salad/ocarina at main

files.Dockerfile.dockerignore:
# What the image leaves out of the build context, app/ (BuildKit reads <Dockerfile>.dockerignore).
node_modules
test
.data
.env*
*.md
files..github/workflows/build.yml:
# Runs the app's tests, builds the app member (app/) into ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ocarina for amd64 and arm64, then pins
# that exact build into k8s/kustomization.yaml, with k8s/platform/ rendered again from app.yaml by
# the platform (arugula-salad/planter's platform-app, at main: a platform change reaches the app on
# its next build). That commit is the deploy: Flux applies k8s/ to the planter-apps namespace on
# home-cloud, serving https://ocarina.apps.arugula.io. A pull request that touches app.yaml or k8s/ is checked: its
# k8s/platform/ must be what its app.yaml renders.
#
# Only a change to the app, its image or app.yaml builds: the other members (box, delivery, design, design-client, decisions, work, answers),
# Markdown and k8s/ do not, so the pin commit below does not trigger another build (GitHub also
# starts no workflow for a push made with GITHUB_TOKEN). workflow_dispatch builds on demand.
# Written by planter (arugula-salad/planter prod-scaffold.mjs); edit it freely.
name: build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "app/**"
      - "!app/**/*.md"
      - "Dockerfile"
      - "Dockerfile.dockerignore"
      - ".github/workflows/build.yml"
      - "app.yaml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "app.yaml"
      - "k8s/**"

concurrency:
  group: build-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/ocarina

jobs:
  platform:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: k8s/platform/ is what app.yaml renders
        uses: arugula-salad/planter/platform-app@main
        with:
          mode: check

  build:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      # The app's own tests, with the whole repo checked out (they read the design member's screen specs).
      - name: App tests
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
          npm test
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: app
          file: Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          push: true
          build-args: |
            APP_REVISION=${{ github.sha }}
          tags: |
            ${{ env.IMAGE }}:latest
            ${{ env.IMAGE }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Render k8s/platform/ from app.yaml
        uses: arugula-salad/planter/platform-app@main
      - name: Pin the image
        run: |
          sed -i -E "s#^(    newTag: ).*#\1sha-${GITHUB_SHA}#" k8s/kustomization.yaml
          git add k8s/
          git diff --cached --quiet && { echo "already pinned and rendered"; exit 0; }
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git commit -m "deploy(ocarina): pin image sha-${GITHUB_SHA::7}"
          git pull --rebase
          git push
files.app.yaml:
# What ocarina needs from the platform. Its build renders k8s/platform/ from this on every build of
# main (arugula-salad/planter, platform-app/render.mjs, says what each key gives).
name: ocarina
health: /health
runtime: k8s
needs:
  domain: [ocarina.apps.arugula.io]
  telemetry: true
files.k8s/kustomization.yaml:
# https://ocarina.apps.arugula.io: ocarina on home-cloud, applied by Flux from this directory. platform/ is rendered
# from app.yaml on every build of main (don't edit it); this file is yours: add kustomize patches here
# for anything app.yaml can't say. Every app shares the `planter-apps` namespace, which the platform
# owns along with the `ghcr` pull secret and the `planter-apps-secrets` ServiceAccount.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: planter-apps
resources:
  - platform
images:
  - name: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ocarina
    # Pinned by .github/workflows/build.yml on every build of main. `unpinned` is a placeholder
    # that does not exist: the app does not run until CI has replaced it.
    newTag: unpinned
files.k8s/platform/deployment.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ocarina
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
spec:
  # Stateless: two replicas, rolled.
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: ghcr
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      # The image runs as the numeric user 1000 (the Dockerfile's USER 1000:1000); a root or named
      # user fails runAsNonRoot with CreateContainerConfigError.
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: ocarina
          image: ghcr.io/arugula-salad/ocarina
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - { name: PORT, value: "8080" }
            - { name: HOST, value: 0.0.0.0 }
            # Where an OpenTelemetry SDK sends traces (Tempo), and what it calls the app. An app
            # without one ignores them.
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, value: "http://tempo.tempo.svc:4318" }
            - { name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL, value: http/protobuf }
            - { name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, value: ocarina }
            - { name: OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, value: "service.namespace=planter-apps,deployment.environment=prod" }
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet: { path: /health, port: http }
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests: { cpu: 10m, memory: 32Mi }
            limits: { memory: 256Mi }
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: [ALL]
          volumeMounts:
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
      volumes:
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir:
            sizeLimit: 256Mi
files.k8s/platform/service.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the app's Service). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ocarina
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
files.k8s/platform/ingressroute.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (https://ocarina.apps.arugula.io). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
# https://ocarina.apps.arugula.io, with port 80 redirected. *.apps.arugula.io resolves to the cluster, so there is no
# DNS step; cert-manager issues the certificate once the route exists.
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: ocarina
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - websecure
  routes:
    - match: Host(`ocarina.apps.arugula.io`)
      kind: Rule
      services:
        - name: ocarina
          port: 80
  tls:
    secretName: ocarina-tls
---
apiVersion: traefik.io/v1alpha1
kind: IngressRoute
metadata:
  name: ocarina-http
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
spec:
  entryPoints:
    - web
  routes:
    - match: Host(`ocarina.apps.arugula.io`)
      kind: Rule
      middlewares:
        # home-cloud's shared redirect middleware.
        - name: redirect-https
          namespace: default
      services:
        - name: ocarina
          port: 80
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: ocarina-tls
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ocarina
spec:
  secretName: ocarina-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: letsencrypt-production
    kind: ClusterIssuer
  dnsNames:
    - ocarina.apps.arugula.io
files.k8s/platform/kustomization.yaml:
# Generated from app.yaml by arugula-salad/planter's platform-app (the list of what it renders). Don't edit: the next
# build of main renders it again. Change app.yaml, or patch it from k8s/kustomization.yaml.
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - deployment.yaml
  - service.yaml
  - ingressroute.yaml
  - dashboard.yaml
